## About
Wavecare Marketing is a healthcare-focused marketing agency that serves senior care facilities, nursing homes, assisted living communities, and medical practices across the United States. We specialize in building trust through visual storytelling — helping facilities attract the right families and fill more beds.

## Services
- Healthcare Branding & Photography: Professional photography of facilities, staff, and resident lifestyle. Facility shots, team portraits, and marketing-ready imagery for websites, social media, admissions materials, and ad campaigns.
- Cinematic Video Production: Virtual facility tours, family-facing story videos, recruitment/culture films, and social/service-line short-form content. All videos are produced specifically for the senior care and healthcare sector.
- Design & Print: Brochures, admissions packets, signage, menus, activity calendars, stationery, business cards, and event collateral. All designed for healthcare audiences with print-ready file delivery.
- Healthcare Web Design: Conversion-first websites built for senior care and medical practices. Includes SEO, Google Business Profile optimization, and local search strategy.

## Who We Serve
- Skilled nursing facilities (SNFs)
- Assisted living and memory care communities
- Continuing care retirement communities (CCRCs)
- Home care and home health agencies
- Medical group practices and outpatient clinics
